title: Pulsating museum signature

location.series: Pentagram / Natural History Museum case study
location.extent: Published video poster and complete associated clip

slide_intent: Use movement to express a recognizable idea, because a logo can communicate more than identification when its behavior has a reason.
strategic_value: The expanding and contracting letter rings can connect the Museum’s initials to the ripple energy described in its identity story.
demonstration: The clip builds a radial NHM symbol beside the white stacked museum name on purple; the rings repeatedly expand and contract while the name stays in place. The PNG is the published symbol-only poster.
practical_value: Compare a moving emblem with a stable name to keep identification readable.

content_islands.name: Radial emblem
content_islands.spec: Animate the colored letter rings on the left, varying their radii around the same center.

content_islands.name: Museum name
content_islands.spec: Keep the white three-line name stationary to the right in the clip.

content_islands.name: Background
content_islands.spec: Hold the dark purple field throughout.

reference_purposes.Expression: The clip builds a radial NHM symbol beside the white stacked museum name on purple; the rings repeatedly expand and contract while the name stays in place. The PNG is the published symbol-only poster.
reference_purposes.Intent: Accompanying Pentagram prose describes the circular NHM formation as a ripple effect representing connection and collective energy.

ingredient.name: Radial NHM symbol
ingredient.role: Connect the initials to an expanding circular form.
ingredient.application: Vary the radius of the letter rings while keeping the name readable beside the emblem.
ingredient.scope: Observed behavior in this presentation; no easing values, durations or minimum sizes are prescribed.
